description: Follows Song Jiang’s encounters at Qingfeng and along the river, his friendship with Li Kui and the Jiangzhou network, and the accusation arising from his Xunyang Tower poem. Traces his rescue and violent retaliation while examining reputational networks, the interpretation of evidence, civilian harm, and the competing political ambitions of Liangshan’s leaders.
